items.text: When you go to work elsewhere, keep your settled home and family there, and return to them when the work is finished.
items.quote: left Wife and Children or some of them there... shall not returne to the place aforesaid when his or theire worke is finished

items.text: Provide for the bringing up of your child born out of wedlock; do not leave the charge upon the parish.
items.quote: for the bringing up and providing for such Bastard Child
